[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing Twilight Monk and always providing your valuable feedback![/p][p]We’ve been working hard the past month and bring you a large update for the Steam version. Twilight Monk has now been updated to version 1.2.0, check below for details on the latest patch![/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdFd1kzaevtmcRehuUr-2AwdeOd1QGi6WKa5OoEUdFSXfLNqimCj9wKnHeJZSHHf4aCoRYkYauZr8Xp--y_vGhG5Yvzg5BCCcIfrNeSy-sUt_97NdUtxERVRI357Ma6CCG5vgla?key=PjLS3zIKTDx41osyQtfJbA"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3][p]・Additional Save points added to the overworld in Central Speria and Arcturo, save option added after any new ability acquired when boss is defeated, save option added after collecting the Triskelion Ring fragments[/p][p]・Added “How to use Talismans” Tutorial.
[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Improvements:[/b][/h3][p]・Damage enhancements through equipping and unequipping talismans are now visible in inventory menu UI.[/p][p]・Translated Key customize feature to all notes.title: Addition of Steam Cloud Feature
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Twilight Monk and always providing your feedback.
Twilight Monk has received an update today, check below for details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/ca17a09fcb5d54d07ea9dfca1ff0605c5e5400f6.png[/img]

[h3]New Feature:[/h3]
・Addition of support of the Cloud Save feature

With this update, the game now supports the Steam Cloud!
This means that save data will be automatically synced between different devices, such as PC and Steam Deck, as long as you are using your Steam account.

[b]⚠Disclaimer[/b]
This title has not supported the Steam Cloud until now, so save data does not exist in the cloud currently. Therefore, when you start/quit the game for the first time after the cloud support is turned on, the save data on that device will be uploaded to the cloud and will become the base data for the game.

Please note that if there is another saved data on another device, it may be overwritten automatically.

Thank you all for always supporting Twilight Monk!
Be sure to check back in for future updates.

- The Twilight Monk Team

notes.title: Twilight Monk Ver. 1.1.0 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Twilight Monk and always providing your feedback. We are really grateful to all of you who not only played Twilight Monk but also took the time to leave thorough feedback! We are constantly reading through everything you write and we are organizing all of the feedback into a comprehensive plan for fixes and updates going forward.

We come to you with the first patch to Twilight Monk! Our goal for this patch is STABILITY, to integrate important features that players have requested urgently (such as custom keyboard bindings) and also improve overall stability.
Check below for details on the contents of this patch.

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
・The key customization has been added for keyboards
・Added tons of new voice over effects for various characters and enemies

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
・Effects when destroying certain monsters (black slimes, gold slimes, ice slimes) have been adjusted to be unique based on monster destroyed
・Did a ton of sound design and sound effect work on enemies and bosses
・Added a new animation for when Raziel summons Hatchi
・Added a new visual for the grappling chain so it matches Raziel’s melee Pillar attack
・Art clean up across all chapters (fixing texture seams, visual glitches, and flickering textures)

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
・Fixed issues where character would get trapped on water’s surface when attempting to dive
・Minor localization fixes for text being too big or too small in UI
・Fixed localization issues with English appearing in other languages for monster descriptions
・Fixing issues with final boss flying too high or too low in phase 3
・Fixing issue where two Vashti appear if defeated while riding the Gazer Beast
・Fixed bug where you could go through the floor while ascending the elevator in Giant’s Crown
・Fixing lots of issues across several locations where shadows weren’t rendering correctly
・Fixed behaviors for the “shadow beings” on the worldmap, when and where they shouldn’t interact with the player/chase the player, etc.
・Lots of work on sound and audio balancing (adjusting for too loud, too quiet, etc.)
・Fixed issue when hovering mouse over scrollbar (even if you can't see cursor) the scroll in options and pause progress was turning white – fixed across several mouse interactions
・Fixing many issues where music, ambient audio tracks, sound effects, etc., weren’t updating based on user’s sound option settings (i.e. turning sound effects all the way off in options, some sounds would still be at full volume)
・Fixed many issues across several enemies that use projectiles, where sometimes projectile visuals weren’t facing the right direction
・Fixed a bug where enemies will stop when you obtain a Spirit Fragment in certain locations
・Lots of minor adjustments on some enemies to provide better feedback on their attacks, timings, etc.



Thank you all for supporting Twilight Monk!
Be sure to check back in for future updates.

- The Twilight Monk Team

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show Highlights and all New Characters!
notes.content:
☯Hello everyone!😈

Welcome to the Official Twilight Monk Team Development Log.

Follow along and get an exclusive look at the Kung-fu fantasy metroidvania game releasing in 2025! If you’re interested to see more exclusive gameplay videos and screenshots, don’t miss out on the action on our [url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game]official X page[/url]! 

[url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/691d024d53fd71e94ff70c9e7916ea74681120a3.png[/img][/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Reflecting on Tokyo Game Show[/h3]
Since this month we’re working on the final chapters of the game, to avoid potential spoilers we’d like to take this opportunity to highlight the Twilight Monk exhibit at Tokyo Game Show instead!

This was the first time a full portion of the final game was made available for the public to enjoy, so the pressure was on. The whole team worked extra hard playtesting, adjusting game balance, and getting localization to a presentable state in time for the show. In the previous demo the player would start right away in the Catacombs without any context leading up or overworld exploration, it was really intended to show the base concepts of the game. This time the ENTIRE first chapter was playable, including the full overworld, many NPC to meet, and 4 dungeons total! The overall volume was enough for a full 30+ minute playthrough but guests were invited to play as much as they could within 15 minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/3f8ff71dbcbbdb041db8a57d88866288fd08f606.gif[/img]

Whereas before there was only 1 minor dungeon and 1 major dungeon to explore, the TGS version included 4 total dungeons: 3 minor (Dojo Path, Hidden Cove, Rotting Burg) and 1 major (The Catacombs).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/cbaf18ac9c88830637d2605ee22cebd657fdc9d3.png[/img]
Overall we were happy to see so many Japanese fans show up to play. The response was overall very positive, with many visitors stopping with curiosity to stare deeply at the poster visuals. Those who decided to play ended up playing right up until the timer went off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/d68c7fdc31dc570b1b01c58b38c341a9d641b235.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/184bedd248a40964cc996ccdab2d99aeb6140fe4.jpg[/img]
Twilight Monk being a game taking a lot of its influence from East Asian culture, we were excited to receive the feedback and reviews from those who played at TGS. 

We prepared mousepads and keyrings and distributed them to anyone who played. By the end of the event we had distributed all 130 of the mousepads that we prepared in addition to all the keyholders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/1b7676c7071a93b633c38b17f7be11fda9a2ef04.jpg[/img]
Overall it was a great event! Now we’re currently preparing for our next exhibit at “Tokyo Game Dungeon 6,” an event held regularly in Tokyo specifically for Indies! We’ve prepared some new goods for the occasion: a set of clear plastic bookmarks that look really cool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/275aa9217b76bebeba3a1a106d1cf19f78642f9c.jpg[/img]
These will also be available as an event-exclusive item for anyone who stops by to play!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]New Enemies and Characters[/h3]
On the development side, we’ve been going back and adding an extra layer of richness to the adventure through new enemy types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/6f99bc828cb1e2798aeb938ccb1fd1fd81e9d3ad.jpg[/img]

The giant muscular carrot is one of Trent’s (Director of Aquatic Moon) personal favorites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/945b1fb193e012f436b4f2698440de91b0282ac5.gif[/img]

Noodles the giant ethereal cat is an NPC that sometimes appears in Crescent Isle and has now been added to all chapters of the game so far. Very cute, very obstructive…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/dba392281b151b022fe232952af92b4113b10d61.jpg[/img]
Additionally some new artwork has been added to flesh out previous locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/a81ab7fb802d23f0c64f825364dc20dc29151180.jpg[/img]
The world of Twilight Monk becomes deeper with every polishing pass, we are constantly playing through and looking for what small details could make the world feel more alive and the gameplay feel more rewarding.

[hr][/hr]
For now we’ll keep making headway on the final chapter of the game, and once that’s wrapped up the whole team will take an additional pass for even more polishing and play testing. We hope you’ll check back in for the next edition!

Until the next one,
- The Twilight Monk Team

notes.title: To the Floating Islands of Japengo: Developer’s Log Vol. 7
notes.content:
☯Hello everyone!😈

Welcome to the Official Twilight Monk Team Development Log.

Follow along and get an exclusive look at the Kung-fu fantasy metroidvania game releasing in 2025! If you’re interested to see more exclusive gameplay videos and screenshots, don’t miss out on the action on our [url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game]official X[/url] page! 

[url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/77f4ca2d1a67c4a7fe991204b000b27f976dad63.png[/img]
[/url]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/b53fa50deca2ee9edd5c78cec7776a5cd394aa9a.jpg[/img]
This past month the team has moved onto the refining phase for Chapter 5. User experience and battle adjustments have continued on since the previous month as well.

Here’s an overview of adjustments that have been made.

[h3]Progress on Chapter 5: The Japengo Islands[/h3]

Chapter 5 will feature the Japengo Islands, a series of floating islands with an exploration expedition into the Cannonballers hideout. With flying being necessary to travel through this region, we added some flying encounters into the overworld.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/d056e41fb8a7f8a1a80a6d20edb2c8894beedf3b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/bc1c95b11bfecf05b1051ee1c3c37ec67b6199d3.png[/img]
We were really trying to capture the feeling of the hideout being a bonafide secret base and incorporated some iconic locations with obstacle gimmicks, such as a kitchen with burning pots that spit fireballs, and a bathroom flooded with water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/0746c751b360775412d2a79ce2f7da3604783d90.png[/img]
Out of any of the dungeons so far we designed this particular dungeon to have the most diverging paths so players could have more freedom in what order and how they explore the dungeon, ultimately designed around opening a series of vault gates to progress deeper in the dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/3114e3721f3815d86102cc441427ff84af82dae6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/eb1b8842c42f7513f651a81c21acee9bda5402e0.png[/img]
[h3]User Experience Adjustments[/h3]
The team have made some adjustments to the user experience this round, including a modified title screen. We wanted it to be a bit more slick and moody, the animated snowfall accompanied by the main theme instrumental really captured this well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/3662d25669cd3d5ecd664c4e9d88c3875afdec11.gif[/img]

New NPCs were added across the main hub of Crescent Isle that give hints and reminders to encourage the player to check back in Crescent Isle to turn in Hunts, get info on the quest, earn money at the arcade, or buy BBQ boost. One example is Nora, she’ll be a character you can encounter in town. Be sure to check back in with her now and then, you might be surprised by what new information she has for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/3a72ea1e60e8cf1d7faf1259bad9d93558eeefc5.png[/img]
Two new NPCs Ketchoope and Moostarde were added for the new region. They’re a pair of adventurers constantly taking jabs at each other, a bit of a knuckle-head duo type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/a9fd131c8875da4e4ce2508c2d0c2254bea966c1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/6a8a036447a8e9b4ef396cc12516cd7d2f55709d.png[/img]
We’re happy to announce there are now 28 Talismans throughout the entire game. Talismans will help improve your characters abilities but also affect your general gameplay. We really hope this will give you all a richer playthrough experience and a playthrough that feels personal to you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/492a4647bcc8ace75dba23b72ba51c0dd717ce66.png[/img]

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
Adjustments to the “feel” of battle are being handled by a dedicated member of our team now. So we are really trying to hone in on subtle elements of speed, timing, and effects to make battle feel satisfying.

For example, now the pillar attack bounces off of walls when the player is too close. The screen shakes when deflecting off of walls, and there are bigger impact slashes when the player hits an enemy, which gives an overall heavier weight to every strike and every hit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/b24f4ec6816a996c86c37aaf56552e7c8110d9fe.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/0cad75111d9698450a49a623668c8b75bcc166db.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
After a few more finalizing touches, we’ll call it a wrap for Chapter 5 and move onto Chapter 6 this coming month. Look forward to all the updates and sneak previews in the upcoming dev log!

Until the next one,
- The Twilight Monk Team

notes.title: Completion of The Dark Forest & Giant’s Crown: Developer’s Log Vol. 6
notes.content:
☯Hello everyone!😈

Welcome to the Official Twilight Monk Team Development Log.

Follow along and get an exclusive look at the Kung-fu fantasy metroidvania game releasing in 2025! If you’re interested to see more exclusive gameplay videos and screenshots, don’t miss out on the action on our[url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game] official X page[/url]! 

[url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/0e14b1536e35f65000fce2ee45c66dba9be243ff.png[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/fae3c3fa9813d0a4077431ced341f2291f707cf7.gif[/img]

This past month the team has been continuing work on Chapter 4 locations the Dark Forest and Giant’s Crown. At this stage they’ve both been finalized and we’re ready to move onto the next region/chapters!

Here’s an overview of adjustments that have been made.

[h3]User Experience Adjustments[/h3]
Several adjustments to the UI were made this time around including the display of NPC portraits. All NPC portraits have been moved to be along the bottom of the screen with larger images. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/e6a2458386eece33eaca1a5a53993e2b08b72ad8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/8cba0de3da5d228bbe747c4cb20f934f6bcd86b1.png[/img]

Though it may appear to be a small change, this was a huge undertaking as there are already so many NPCs scripted into the game, so ALL of them had to be reworked... But with this change you can really appreciate the level of detail put into each character portrait which makes it all worthwhile.

Additionally, we added a section for talismans to the inventory, these will be used for additional skills and enhancements during your playthrough.

We finalized some key animated sequences as well, including this particular encounter with a certain forest spirit… maybe if you were paying attention in the previous dev log you’ll know who this is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/8e2ded580e27291b5de0d3d42406b043d3802ac9.jpg[/img]

The boss battle at Giant’s Crown has been visually finalized, too. We don’t want to spoil too much, but here’s a screenshot of the boss battle with the Sky Pirate gang’s leader, Pepperoni… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/77f34fa47257ae902c75091f804e38f08551df3f.jpg[/img]

It'll be very hectic, and we played on the fact that as a Cannonballer, she can literally turn into a cannonball, so naturally… we added some pinball mechanics! This battle definitely has the most components so far.

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
Tons of playtesting amongst the team has led to a lot of minor improvements in level design and fine-tuning of enemy difficulty. As you play we don’t want beating enemies to become mundane, so we made a lot of adjustments so the enemies’ skills and difficulty level are adjusted to all the new skills you collect as you progress through the game.

[hr][/hr]
From here on, the entire team is focused on Chapter 5 content for the month of August (the southern Islands of Japengo). Stay tuned for the upcoming Dev Log at the end of next month!

Until the next one,
- The Twilight Monk Team

notes.title: A Mysterious Forest and City Under Siege: Developer’s Log Vol. 5
notes.content:
☯Hello everyone!😈

Welcome to the Official Twilight Monk Team Development Log.

Follow along and get an exclusive look at the Kung-fu fantasy metroidvania game releasing in 2025! If you’re interested to see more exclusive gameplay videos and screenshots, don’t miss out on the action on [url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game]our official X page[/url]! 

[url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/4c1502307a12843bf3a7c15980e4702b4d319c80.png[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]
This month we’ve been continuing refinement of the Eastern continent and two major locations that are directly pulled from the original Twilight Monk novel series! This should be exciting for fans of the books as they can see two iconic locations brought to life!

[h3]The Darkroot Forest[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/8ad1330aaef6234874377c55d8d852b7a00b4bef.jpg[/img]
Though last time we accessed the Jabah Dooba desert via boat, this time around Raziel will have to ride the very spooky ghost train to reach his destination…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/af8872e35c52b387faf28ee68bc47d3020e6909e.jpg[/img]
We wanted the conductor to be a little comical, with some cheesy Halloween style jokes in his back pocket.

Stylistically, this has to be one of the team’s favorite dungeons so far! It took a lot of inspiration from games like Legend of Zelda which always have some sort of “lost forest”. You’ll find yourself a bit lost at times as this dungeon is particularly maze-like. Here’s a look at the result of polishing this time around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/e9d463bd7203567e37b0d69e2b0febd0470337d4.gif[/img]

The overworld area received a rework to have a richer purple tone, as well as a strong light emanating from the entrance to the Dark Forest so it’s a little bit easier to know where to go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/bb5c1a2b2a495d4989029d5bcc3690d70cec2d33.gif[/img]

Many areas that were still in a preliminary state have been finalized with atmosphere and detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/ad86816476426b73acf47676794db288e397ea2e.gif[/img]

Refinement of new mechanics in this dungeon, as you can see there is a fireball that gets released when you’ve used the Phantom Pillar to activate it. You can kick it around and burn vine walls that block your way!

The color scheme has been adjusted quite a bit to be a little darker and moodier, and effects and details have all been added in at this stage. More NPC portraits this time around, including our cute little friend Amiku!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/974116fbc3b04dac854f31b17d0ecc6d8445fb10.gif[/img]

[h3]Giant’s Crown[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/bd3be56428b38d11b76675678a138684d41cb253.jpg[/img]
Giant’s crown is a city overrun by the “Cannon Ballers”, a group of Sky Pirates at war with the residents seeking to defend their territory - the “Blokes”.

We’ve put a lot of special attention into designing diverging paths for the player to explore. You’ll be navigating the dungeon and restoring power to various sections to activate elevators and contraptions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/36e7204686c7c826518542c820261546f4884692.jpg[/img]
Some more underwater chasms that connect to old mining areas as well! We tried to create lots of optional paths within this dungeon so we hope when you play you’ll enjoy going back and discovering all the secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/8077c3dad5f9de8fa027317a50dc482ee60e1a1c.gif[/img]

[h3]Additional Content[/h3]

Besides these two locations, we’ve added in some new content including these cute little guys, Bojo Birds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/8b84bb7575a2ac19fd149e7371dab46506aaca8c.gif[/img]

They will be collectible throughout your adventures in Speria, so see if you can manage to collect them all!

To find out where they’re hiding, leave it to the “papa Bojos” who will show you the way to their locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/973f26c2a4efe30b9a3635833bae8389b16aa6a8.gif[/img]

Plus a few new enemies, such as these cauldron enemies which suck the life force out of Raz until he’s able to successfully destroy 5 of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/531a062d6fc5bf24ae9d1e4e57da18991d5c1767.gif[/img]

We hope there’s something among the new content that piques your interest! Thank you always for following along and we’re looking forward to sharing more progress and sneak peaks in the next update.

Until the next one,
- The Twilight Monk Team

notes.title: To the Sweltering Desert: Developer’s Log Vol. 4
notes.content:
☯Hello everyone!😈

Welcome to the Official Twilight Monk Team Development Log.

Follow along and get an exclusive look at the Kung-fu fantasy metroidvania game releasing in 2025! If you’re interested to see more exclusive gameplay videos and screenshots, don’t miss out on the action on our  [url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game]official Twilight Monk X[/url] page! 

[url=https://x.com/TwiMonk_Game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/971dc631d0279af0dbb05cd6d03b11f617dedc4c.png[/img][/url]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/b947b722bd4c3c97b7ae54af370c6cdcd8c42f95.jpg[/img]
This time around, we’ll be diving into the third chapter…

[u][h3]The Jabah Dooba Desert[/h3][/u]
Raziel makes his way to the Western continent via a new form of overworld travel: ship🚢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/6d3c978b77efd113a034224d40680555813553b5.jpg[/img]
This being our largest overworld, we put special attention into making the environment as rich as possible. So we spent quite a bit of time updating the overworld from its earlier build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/2fd58a8ad92c3ecaff5c8bc4df02656268454aa2.gif[/img]

As you can see, pretty significant improvements have been made. Besides the UI improvements, assets such as the swaying trees have been added, and overall contrast and brightness has been enhanced. 

We also went in and finalized portions of the dungeon that were still left in a preliminary state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/08e6bc2dc0e3f8716eb52d18c17a2702cf55d408.gif[/img]

More NPC’s have been added to this round of polishing with dialogues that will change based on how far you’ve progressed in the main quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/9c04d69c6a2f03165a55d4409709eaab8241fc57.jpg[/img]
Lastly, we finalized the underwater system! This will be an interesting contrast to the usual combat you do on land since you won’t be able to use your Phantom Pillar weapon. The ruins in the desert will have a combination of sand filled dungeons as well as underwater chasms to dive into to access different areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/1b7b9dde7bf730c64130aaaf9b22f7ed4c4ac71c.jpg[/img]
These underwater levels will of course come with new enemy types as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/40111d07d2cec7311723a179968a5a2f758a6606.gif[/img]

Progress is going smoothly and we’re moving right along into the polishing phase for Chapter 4. Look forward to details on the next continent in the upcoming Developer’s Log!

The only other news to report for now is that more progress has been made on the Switch port of the game, things are going well for now with steady progress.

To commemorate the fourth Development Log, don’t miss the new concept art added in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1911940/images/]“Artworks”[/url] section; it's an early concept for the town in Jabah Dooba desert. 

We hope all these new images are igniting your imaginations and painting a picture of how expansive the world of Twilight Monk is! Thank you always for following along and we’re looking forward to sharing more progress and sneak peaks in the next update.

Until the next one,
- The Twilight Monk Team

notes.title: Depths of the Icy Tundra: Developer’s Log Vol. 3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/40d79340e6a913921f939548b18fc01d8f33cf48.png[/img]
☯Hello everyone!😈

Welcome to the Official Twilight Monk Team Development Log! 

Follow along monthly and get an exclusive look at development progress for the Kung-Fu fantasy releasing in 2025!

This time around, we’ll be diving into the second chapter of our epic journey…


[h3]The Mountain Pass and Sky Fortress[/h3]

This month’s focus was polishing story and game elements for Chapter 2, which explores Raz’s journey into the Northern continent of Speria, an unforgivingly cold and frozen mountainous region. Unlike in Chapter 1 where we were exploring deep underground chambers, now we are ascending high into the sky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/7f535384703f20e0dd0aeeec2c19e65d77cc4cbd.gif[/img]

As you can see we used a different color scheme to express the cold environment, unlike the predominantly green tones used for the previous chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/a36733164943dd59af156496d2059d92a8cd7211.jpg[/img]

Though Raz is warned of the dangers ahead by elevator operator Grim, he insists on entering the mountain and takes the elevator up. 

Just as Grim had warned, the way is littered with dangers including Razor Fang, a hunter of Moonken such as Raz, convinced that all Moonken are bound to succumb to darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/0be1e6b6a09d38098485d5cd0d5fd59d6cacdb1b.gif[/img]

To climb higher through the dungeon you’ll be needing to ride all sorts of elevators, platforms, and contraptions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/543730e553e27a27b371776cb28a107af6ed531e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/072a8ec1cd42c56bad7d5d0bf0e2aae1317b6680.gif[/img]

Raz will continue his ascent until he reaches the very top of the Sky Fortress. What mysteries lie ahead and what treasures are waiting to be discovered…?


[h3]New Features Implemented[/h3]
[b]BBQ[/b]
The difficulty level will crank up this time around, so be sure to eat some BBQ to receive buffs during your next outing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/f7cb50c88e9fb638421557ff5aca109073e90198.jpg[/img]

[b]Double-boss encounter fights[/b]
Chapter 2 will include the first double boss encounter, get ready for an added layer of difficulty

[b]Mini-maps[/b]
The dungeons will become increasingly complex, make sure to check the mini map so you don’t lose your way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/67f7e99cbb9e0303b4f0f7eaa39bf0997596b7fd.jpg[/img]

[b]Game-plus difficulty mode[/b]
Upon completion of the game you’ll be able to unlock an extra difficult version to replay and challenge yourself!


Be sure to follow along all socials and wishlist to keep up to date on developments!

And as always, to commemorate the third Development Log, take a look at the new concept artwork added in the “Artworks” section!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1911940/images/


Until the next one.
- The Twilight Monk Team

notes.title: 12 Languages, New Features!: Developer’s Log Volume 2
notes.content:
☯Hello everyone!😈

Welcome to the Official Twilight Monk Team Development Log! 

Follow along monthly and get an exclusive look at development progress for the Kung-Fu fantasy releasing in 2025!

April marks the finalization of all Chapter 1 content, which is a HUGE milestone for the whole team! The full main story of Chapter 1 is now completely playable, boss fights, cut scenes, features, and all!

So how about we take a look at some of what’s in store?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/ce1265ca125595ea792fd1bf510604197764a211.gif[/img]

All the key battles have been implemented, here we’ve got a little preview of Raz’s battle with the “Lazy Swordsmen”, Jubee hired them to lend a helping hand but actually they seem to have other plans...

Important cutscenes have also been finalized, here we have a key moment in the adventures of Chapter 1 involving a bell hanging in the Rotting Burg?
It’s just begging for a good STRIKE, in’t it…?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/b1cfa4af368151ddcaf17139fe1b2a12face13c4.gif[/img]

Don’t be too rough or it might fall, surely something that heavy would break right through the floor… Let’s just say interacting with certain objects will be key to opening up the map and discovering new areas 😉

[h2]New Features Implemented:[/h2]

[h3]The Teleportation Tree:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/067a1f8ae04e14923693521244f37790bb7c9b96.gif[/img]

Used to easily warp between areas you’ve explored before.

[h3]The Monster Book:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/4a47291cd08664f0f491824a792c1c4795d4aeed.gif[/img]

Admire the designs and read on the lore of each baddie you’ve taken down, of course important stats are also detailed in each entry.

[h3]Hunts:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/5c912ca3c28988550d3a092f6e345d263e055cb8.jpg[/img]

Discover new monsters and take them down to complete hunt missions! Report your progress to Master Yibatta to collect special rewards and upgrades!

Besides all this here’s a report of other things we’ve been working on:
[list]
[*] Added multi language support function for 12 languages! (Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Russian, Italian, Japanese, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, and Korean!)
[*] Finalizing entire game script to prepare for translation 
[*] Nintendo porting is in progress!
[*] New music tracks for Chapter 2
[*] A TON of animation for the final chapters
[*] Enemy behaviors adjusted for different in-game scenarios
[*] A lot of playtesting, bug fixes
[*] Tutorial menus added at key points to introduce game features
[*] Character NPC portraits updated
[/list]

Interesting fun fact about production: half our team is actually in the UK! Thanks to the time difference it’s a significant amount of extra hours of progress while our team in the States calls in for the day.

We hope you’re as excited as we are with the progress so far. More updates and refinement to come. This is just the first of 6 chapters!

As an extra treat to commemorate the second Development Log update, take a look at the new concept artwork of the Gazer Rider boss added in the “Artworks” section!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1911940/images/

Until the next one.
The Twilight Monk Team

notes.title: Developer's Log: Volume 1
notes.content:
☯Hello everyone!😈

Welcome to the Twilight Monk Team’s first Community Update! 
Follow along monthly and get an exclusive, detailed look at development progress on the upcoming Kung-Fu fantasy releasing in 2025!

March has been a busy month, we’ve been working hard on development for the past year and are finally arriving at a point where the team can work back from the beginning and polish content. It’s all getting to a point where we are ready to share longer-length video clips, so stay up to date as we’ll be sharing all this and more in future community updates! 

This month we’ve achieved most of our goals for polishing Chapter 1, which focuses on Central Speria and Crescent Isle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/a506702399ab38946cdd0ecee6f4ee53d0ca8183.jpg[/img]
Pictured above is Crescent Isle, the main hub in the game that you’ll be returning to throughout your journey. As you progress in the game, more townsfolk will move in and shops will open up, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/c859abfb143f5242d675dda488bcf50b2d542275.jpg[/img]
Stop by Bighead’s shop to pick up essential items.

The major dungeons will be the Dojo Path and the Catacombs, an area that lies beneath the Rotting Burg.

Dojo Path:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/598633c36be49befa8b86a330e6e013985c24381.jpg[/img]

As you can see we are utilizing weather elements to create a different mood for this dungeon, something we’ll be playing with in future dungeons as well.

Rotting Burg:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/9a2ff7cf66b798e3ca5b52c347e75014b760981a.png[/img]

Rather than rain, in the RottingBurg we have a misty fog hanging low to the ground. In the distance you can make out remnants of the crumbling city, too. 

The Catacombs:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/6e6d3bf987efad9f6ca7c77cf46d1782bf78d5db.jpg[/img]

Littered with undead, traps, and even illusory walls - there’s as much to discover in this dungeon as there is danger.

We’ve got other items that are not quite ready to show, but here’s what we’ve been making headway with this month!
[list]
[*] Refining of the in-game monster book
[*] Opening cutscene (complete!), other cutscenes in development
[*] Polishing of boss fights
[*] Teleporting function between dungeons via the “Teleportation Tree”
[*] BBQ in the main hub (!?)
[*] More fog and weather effects (this has dramatically improved the mood of each environment!)
[*] Enhanced animation of NPCs and dialog scenes for more immersive gameplay
[*] Details to the UI of the world map for easier playability
[/list]

Check back in for future updates! For now - be sure to wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1911940/Twilight_Monk/ 

Follow socials to get even more up to date looks at Twilight Monk production.
https://twitter.com/TwiMonk_Game Twitter

Be sure to pick up some Twilight Monk wallpapers from the “Artwork” section of the Twilight Monk Steam Community, too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42065721/f77a49665d15a10e36239d0a10271306886baca7.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3204721326

Until the next one.
- The Twilight Monk Team
